item.title: Site rebuild and newly documented projects
item.description:
First entry in this notebook, on the occasion of a full site rebuild.

The site

The site now runs on Hugo + the Hextra theme, with:

  • a bilingual FR/EN version
  • dark theme by default, built-in search
  • an “Edit this page” link on every page leading straight to the source file on GitHub
  • GitHub Pages deployment via GitHub Actions, with a build check on pull requests

New project pages

The rebuild comes with documentation for about ten active repositories that weren’t listed yet:

  • StageNeth — OpenWrt-based router OS for live performance (AV VLANs, PTP, Dante/AES67/ST 2110)
  • aes67_visualizer — AoIP stream visualizer (AES67, RAVENNA, Dante, ST 2110-30)
  • ptp-monitor — passive PTP clock listening for AoIP network diagnostics
  • DewiCom — local WiFi PTT intercom for stage technicians
  • audio-accessibility-system — audio description / hearing assistance distribution via PWA
  • nextevents & openagenda-slides — OpenAgenda event slideshows for digital signage
  • holophonix-animator-blender — Holophonix animations as a native Blender addon
  • clock_X_overlay — always-on-top OSD clock for Linux X11
  • fooyin-album-mosaic-plugin — animated album-cover mosaic for Fooyin
  • the oppo-bdp Companion module added to the modules page

Next up: technical notes as projects evolve — lessons learned, architectures, pitfalls.
